patch_description: Add a final constrained maximin refinement in barycentric coordinates. The stochastic coordinate search is useful for discovering an oriented-matroid cell, but its soft-tail selection does not accurately solve the nonsmooth maximum-minimum problem within that cell. Once a good state is found, fix each determinant’s observed sign and use SLSQP to maximize an explicit lower-bound variable subject to every signed determinant exceeding it and every free point remaining in the simplex. In a fixed sign cell these are smooth constraints, so this directly targets the normalized minimum area rather than the surrogate tail score. The refinement is protected by exception handling and only replaces the search result after exact area verification.
